description: Change vehicle coloring in sumo-gui to display speed information using the Bologna Acosta scenario. The sumo-gui application is already open with the Bologna Acosta real-world road network loaded (from the Acosta area in Bologna, Italy). The simulation is loaded but not yet started. Your task is to: 1. Open the Edit Visualization dialog by pressing F9 (or go to Edit > Edit Visualization). 2. In the Visualization Settings dialog, click the 'Vehicles' tab on the left sidebar. 3. Under the 'Color' dropdown at the top of the Vehicles section, change the coloring scheme from the default ('given vehicle/type/route color') to 'by speed'. 4. Click 'OK' to apply the changes and close the dialog. 5. Start the simulation by pressing Ctrl+A (this runs the simulation continuously). Vehicles will appear on the roads color-coded by speed. 6. Take a screenshot of the visualization using the system screenshot tool: open a terminal and run 'scrot /home/ga/SUMO_Output/speed_coloring.png'.
